items.fact: It depends on the course's requirement
items.detail: Many universities also accept TOEFL, PTE or Duolingo. Check the official site.

items.myth: You can take IELTS only once
items.detail: You can take it any number of times. Learn from past mistakes and try again.

items.myth: Your accent is judged in Speaking
items.fact: Clarity and fluency are what count
items.detail: Speak clearly and smoothly in your own accent. That's enough.

youtube.title: No admit without IELTS? Myth vs Fact
youtube.description:
3 myths about English tests. The requirement depends on the course (many universities also accept TOEFL, PTE or Duolingo), you can retake IELTS, and in speaking it's clarity and fluency that count, not your accent. Free IELTS resources: app.goeduabroad.com/ielts-online-test-kit

👉 https://app.goeduabroad.com

EduAbroad: Run by Harvard-Cambridge Alumni. 100% private. You contact us, we never contact you first.
